focused_findings: The only loader behavior added before opt-in is zero-initialized nrc_loader_owner and token parsing. nrc_loader_optin accepts exactly one whitespace-delimited nord2wifirom=1 token; absent token returns0; duplicate or malformed matching token fails to stock chain-back, before any CONN action.

The opt-in branch follows payload magic/version/window/ADT-size validation and precedes kernel segment copy and ADT patching. It bounds declared FDT size to 40..1MiB, rejects pointer overflow and overlap with the proposed CONN range, then invokes the hardened original-FDT fixed-selection parser. It does not write CONN DRAM or alter the original FDT.

The candidate ADT adds one zeroed /chosen/nord2-conn-claim value, exactly 24 little-endian bytes: base u64, size u64, source u32, valid u32. patch_chosen fills it from the parser's claim; a missing or duplicate property under opt-in is fatal. An absent opt-in leaves it zero, preserving default-off signaling.

The hardened parser requires root and reserved-memory address/size cells 2, empty reserved-memory ranges, no nested reserved buses, no duplicate defining nodes/properties, DRAM containment, and non-overlap with every fixed reserved reg and FDT memreserve entry. Saved live.dtb passes its ASan/UBSan host test; synthetic CCCI overlap is refused. AArch64 freestanding compile passes.
integration_limits: This records a loader policy claim, not hardware exclusion against undocumented LK/secure/other-master users or an AP/CONN MPU permission proof; firmware writes remain unwired and prohibited in this candidate.

The loader handles the explicit iOS fixed-selection route only. If the current live FDT supplies a fixed CONN reg or LK emi-addr/emi-size tag, the parser refuses this path; an inherited route would need a separate reviewed branch.

The private mkadt script imports tools/adt.py through PYTHONPATH=tools in this checkout. It generated a 10084-byte test ADT with one nord2-conn-claim property. On promotion to tools/mkadt-nord2.py, its normal same-directory import path applies.
No linked image, device, current-boot FDT, SMC, DRAM or firmware result was obtained from this private loader candidate.
actions: Read-only focused diff review of parent files; parser hardened only in separate private rom-native-candidate directory; no active source, CI, USB, device, NOTES or production edit.
